name: HXT_WC_CLICKED_TIMES
description: This table stores web clock events and time information clicked by users

columns.name: WC_CLICKED_TIME_ID
columns.description: Primary key

columns.name: WORK_FROM_HOME_FLAG
columns.description: Flag for Work From Home

columns.name: DEVICE_TYPE
columns.description: Device Type of the Time Event

columns.name: GEO_LOCATION
columns.description: Geo Coordinates of the time event

columns.name: GEO_LOC_EXCEPTION
columns.description: Indicates the reason why geo coordinates were not captured

columns.name: GEOFENCE_ERROR
columns.description: Identifies why geofence validation failed for web clock event.

columns.name: GEOFENCE_VAL_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates geofence validation succeeded or not for web clock event.

columns.name: TIME_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Stores the Id returned by time event api

columns.name: CLICKED_TIME_STRING
columns.description: Stores device time if there is no adjustement else it contains the adjusted time

columns.name: DEVICE_CLICKED_TIME_STRING
columns.description: Stores the initial device time before adjustement. If there is no adjustement, this field is empty

columns.name: CLICKED_SERVER_TIME
columns.description: Stores the server clicked time

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Stores the enterprise id of the user

columns.name: MANUAL_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N. Indicates if the time was entered manually by the worker or not. Considered as 'N' if empty.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Stores the person id of the user clicked the event

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Stores the assignment id of the user clicked the event

columns.name: TCLAYFLD_DEFNS_ID
columns.description: Id of the Time Card Field

columns.name: TCLAYFLD_DEFNS_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: Id of the TCF used in a layout set

columns.name: CLICKED_TIME
columns.description: Stores the system clicked time

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: The value stored in this column is used for business logic rule

columns.name: REF_TIMEZONE_ID
columns.description: The time zone associated to the Click time

columns.name: TIMEZONE_OFFSET
columns.description: TIMEZONE_OFFSET

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
